messages.subject: committed code re-org
parts:
Daniel and I went through the stan/ directory
structure and removed what we don't need and cleaned
up everything else with an eye toward what a user
who downloads the tarball will see.

Here's an overview of how things are now. (But
I'm about to pull a .sty out for our manuals and
then break the reference manual into pieces.)
I'll also add my talk for the meetup.

Stan Directory Structure
------------------------
This is both the layout in Git and the layout in
our distribution tarball (keeping them the same makes
life MUCH easier).

An asterisk (*) means the file/directory is created
programatically. These files are made and included
in the tarball distributions, but not checked into
Git.
